critique.title: WeDo as a JSON Subset (Pseudolanguage vs Syntax)

definitions.pseudolanguage: Markdown-based approximate intent requiring regex parsing.
definitions.syntax: JSON-based rigid set of rules for expressing intent, liability, and status.

benefits: Interoperability: Stays valid JSON while serving as instructional nerves.
Metabolic Rigidity: Establishes 'Rigid Wood' required for Artificial Life.
Forensic Tracking: Diff-based attribution and proof of labor.
critique.conclusion: Markdown is best for Wood (History) and Air (Narrative). JSON Subset is best for Nerves (Instructions) and Metabolism (State).
